quote: From the most holy water I returned / Regenerate, in the manner of new trees / That are renewed with a new foliage, / Pure and disposed to mount unto the stars.
source: Dante Alighieri, Purgatorio, Canto XXXIII, lines 142 to 145, the closing lines (trans. Henry Wadsworth Longfellow, 1867)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg eBook 1002, Divine Comedy, Longfellow's Translation, Purgatory, downloaded and read

evidence.locator: Canto XXXIII, the final tercet and closing single line (lines 142 to 145), after Matilda leads him to Eunoe

reason: Read verbatim as the last four lines of the canticle, lineation and line-head capitals as printed. Not shipped; Dante stands at one of three (month 1), so this is his second.
